Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrite positivity, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, consistent with a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and mild proteinuria may reflect inflammation. Low specific gravity suggests dilute urine. Glucosuria is noted but may be transient or warrants further evaluation for glycemic status. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy.
